title: Status pages
subtitle: Publish trusted incident updates and service health to your customers.

page.subtitle: Identity, locale, visibility, and customer-facing branding.
page.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens. Slugs are globally unique.
page.languages_hint: Select one or more interface languages. More than one enables the public switcher; component and incident content stays as written.
page.timezone_hint: Use an IANA timezone such as UTC, Asia/Shanghai, or Europe/Berlin.
page.history_days_hint: Show resolved incidents from the past 1–{{max}} days, up to 200 events. Defaults to 90.
page.logo_upload_hint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 2 MiB. The file is uploaded when you save.
page.logo_type_error: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
page.logo_size_error: The logo must be no larger than 2 MiB.
page.logo_preview_error: The current logo preview is unavailable.
page.logo_url_hint: Optional. Use an HTTPS or root-relative image URL instead of an uploaded file.
page.color_hint: Six-digit hex color used for the public page brand rail.
page.domain_hint: After provisioning, this hostname opens the status page at its HTTPS root (/). DNS and certificate setup remain separate.

component.subtitle: Components communicate the health of a customer-visible capability.

incident.subtitle: Customers see this update immediately when the page is public.
incident.publication_hint: Create an independent event or optionally link an active internal incident.
incident.source_hint: Linking an internal incident is optional and never publishes automatically.
incident.start_hint: Entered in your browser timezone and displayed publicly in {{timezone}}.
incident.message_placeholder: Describe what customers are experiencing and what your team is doing.

update.title: Publish incident update
update.hint: Each update is appended to the public timeline. Resolved incidents are immutable.
update.message_placeholder: Share concrete progress, mitigations, or recovery confirmation.

event.incident_subtitle: Draft first or publish a customer-facing incident immediately.
event.maintenance_subtitle: Schedule, reschedule, and complete planned work.

states.empty_description: Create a public communication surface for incidents, maintenance, and service health.
states.no_components_description: Add the customer-visible capabilities whose health you want to communicate.
states.add_component_first: Add at least one component before publishing an incident.
states.no_history: No completed events match these filters.
states.private_page_unavailable: Private pages require an approved email address.
states.no_archived_pages_description: Archived pages remain recoverable for 30 days before purge.
states.archived_read_only: This status page is archived and read-only.
states.event_unavailable: This event could not be loaded.
states.no_access_rules: No allowlist rules. Nobody can request access yet.

toast.logo_upload_failed: The page was saved, but the logo upload failed: {{error}}

confirm.delete_page_description: “{{name}}” and its public history will be permanently removed.
confirm.delete_component_description: “{{name}}” can only be deleted when it is not referenced by incident history.
confirm.archive_page_description: “{{name}}” will stop publishing and can be restored for 30 days.

general.title: General
general.description: Identity, visibility, delivery retention, and private session lifetime.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Logo and brand color used by the customer-facing status page.

localization.title: Localization and history
localization.description: Languages, timezone, and the public history window.

domain.title: Custom domain and TLS
domain.description: Verify ownership, validate routing, and provision a managed TLS certificate.
domain.unavailable_description: Set this MoleSignal instance’s public URL and managed TLS options in the server configuration, or use the corresponding MS_HTTP_* environment variables, then restart MoleSignal.

private_access.title: Private access
private_access.description: Allow exact emails or domains. Magic links are one-use and sessions last {{count}} days.
private_access.public_description: Change visibility to Private in General settings to configure an email allowlist and Magic Link sessions.
private_access.sessions_description: Sessions are bound to the status-page origin and can be revoked at any time.

access.title: Email verification required
access.description: Enter an approved email address. We will send a one-time link that expires in 15 minutes.
access.requested: If this address is allowed, an access link is on its way. You can close this page.
access.invalid_link: This access link is invalid or has expired.

public.not_found_description: This page is private, no longer exists, or the address is incorrect.
public.load_error: The status page could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
public.no_components: No service components have been published.
public.no_history: No incidents reported within the configured history window.
public.no_recent_incidents: No incidents reported within the configured history window.

subscription.title: Get status updates
subscription.description: Choose email or an HTTPS webhook. We will send a confirmation before activating notifications.
subscription.email_hint: Open the confirmation link in the email to start receiving updates.
subscription.webhook_hint: The HTTPS endpoint must accept a confirmation request before updates are sent.
subscription.private_email_hint: Notifications will be sent to the verified email address used for this private session.
subscription.accepted_description: A confirmation has been sent. Notifications remain disabled until you confirm.
subscription.action_failed: This subscription link is invalid or no longer available.

archive.history_description: Resolved incidents from the configured {{count}}-day history window. Each month highlights the three most severe.
archive.no_history: No resolved incidents were reported in this history window.
archive.uptime_description: Daily component status from recorded status changes and published incidents across the configured {{count}}-day window. Planned maintenance is excluded from uptime.
archive.no_uptime_components: No service components have been published.

uptime.chart_label_unavailable: {{name}} has no uptime data for the past 90 days
uptime.no_data: No component status was recorded for this day.
uptime.no_downtime: No downtime recorded on this day.
uptime.no_incident_details: No related public incident details are available.

overall_description.degraded_performance: Some {{name}} services are slower than expected. We are monitoring the impact.
overall_description.partial_outage: Some {{name}} services are affected. We are working to restore them.
overall_description.major_outage: Multiple {{name}} services are unavailable. We are actively responding.
overall_description.maintenance: Planned maintenance is currently affecting some {{name}} services.

incident_detail.no_updates: No public updates have been posted yet.
incident_detail.not_found_description: This incident does not exist or is no longer included on this status page.
